name: pi-openai-tts
description: TTS provider for any OpenAI-compatible API gateway. Implements the TtsProvider contract from pi-telegram-tts-minimax; registers with id 'pi-openai-tts'. Talks POST /v1/audio/speech. Voices: alloy, echo, fable, onyx, nova, shimmer. Models: tts-1, tts-1-hd. Response formats: mp3, opus (default for Telegram), aac, flac, wav, pcm. Config (first non-empty wins): explicit TtsRequest.{voice,model,speed,responseFormat} > extensions['pi-openai-tts'].{voice,model,base_url,api_key} in telegram.json > OPENAI_TTS_{VOICE,MODEL,BASE_URL,FORMAT} env vars > ~/.pi/agent/auth.json (api_key only) > smart default (https://api.openai.com/v1).
